Note 1. Description of Organization and Business Operations

Churchill Capital Corp X was a blank check company incorporated for the purpose of effecting a merger with one or more businesses (the "Business Combination"). Funds held in the Trust Account were to be used to complete the initial Business Combination.

Liquidity and Going Concern

As of December 31, 2025, the conditions related to the mandatory liquidation date raised substantial doubt about the Company's ability to continue as a going concern; such substantial doubt was alleviated due to the closing of the Business Combination on February 13, 2026.
